config:
[backend]
kind = "metal"

[backend.metal]
graph_replay = "tier2"
pool_capacity = "auto"

[bench]
breakdown = false
contexts = [9, 512, 2048, 4000]
decode_prefill = 8
pp = 512
reps = 30
selection = ["gpu-sequential", "gpu-pipelined"]
tg = 128
warmups = 3

[bench.sampling]
seed = 0
temperature = 0.0
top_k = 0
top_p = 1.0

[bench.vary]

[engine]
replay = true

[engine.tunings]
add = []
base = "profile"
remove = []

[engine.variant-picks]

[engine.variant-rules]

[limits]
dispatches_per_list = 4096
gpu_time_budget = "3600000ms"
guest_call_timeout = "300000ms"
guest_memory_bytes = 4294967296
instances = 10000
live_bytes = "auto"
live_graphs = 16
live_kernels = 64
live_tensor_handles = 20000
read_bytes = 1073741824
submission_timeout = "60000ms"
table_elements = 10000
tensor_elements = 1000000000
tensor_rank = 4
work_per_dispatch = "unlimited"

[run]
max_tokens = 128
temperature = 0.0
top_k = 0
top_p = 1.0

[verify]
prompts = []
